items.title: It's Homemade Bread Day
items.text: In the US, November 17 is a day to bake your own bread at home. The idea is simple: flour, water, yeast, a warm kitchen and a lot of patience while the dough rises.
items.mean: flour and water mixed together, before you bake it
items.es: En EE. UU., el 17 de noviembre es el día de hornear tu propio pan en casa.
items.q: What's a bread or food from your country that everyone should try at least once?

items.title: Shooting stars tonight: the Leonids
items.text: The Leonid meteor shower peaks tonight and tomorrow morning. Look up between midnight and dawn, far from city lights, and you might see a few meteors every hour. No telescope needed!
items.mean: the moment when the sun starts to come up
items.es: La lluvia de meteoros Leónidas llega a su punto máximo esta noche y mañana temprano.
items.q: Have you ever seen a shooting star? Where were you, and did you make a wish?

items.title: A coyote tried the world's biggest animal bridge first
items.text: Near Los Angeles, a huge bridge for wildlife goes over a 10-lane freeway. It opens officially on December 2, but cameras already caught a coyote walking across it. It couldn't wait!
items.mean: animals that live free in nature, not pets or farm animals
items.es: Cerca de Los Ángeles, un puente gigante para animales cruza una autopista. Una cámara ya captó a un coyote cruzándolo.
items.q: If you could build something to help animals in your city, what would it be?
